title: Balanced Skeleton
description: Balanced Skeletons fixes that by making skeletons less oppressive while keeping them part of the game.
body:
Balanced Skeletons


 Skeletons can be frustrating, especially in large modpacks. They shoot too fast, too far, and too accurately, making combat feel unfair even with good gear.

  Balanced Skeletons fixes that by making skeletons less oppressive while  keeping them part of the game.
  Features
- Reduces skeleton arrow damage
- Slows down skeleton attack speed
- Shortens attack range
- Adds real inaccuracy (they miss more often)
- Works with Skeletons and Strays
- Optional Wither Skeleton support
- Fully configurable
- Skeleton Difficulty

 Choose how strong skeletons should be:

- Vanilla+ – Light nerf, close to vanilla
- Balanced – Recommended default
- Easy Mode – Strong nerf for hard modpacks
- Custom – Use your own values

 Changing the difficulty automatically updates all balance settings.

Config Options
Enable/disable the mod
Damage multiplier
Attack delay
Attack range
Inaccuracy multiplier
Toggle Strays / Wither Skeletons
Debug logging
Purpose

 This mod is designed for players and modpacks that feel skeletons are too strong or annoying, especially when combined with many other mobs.

It keeps skeletons dangerous, but makes combat more fair.

Notes
Does not change drops, health, or spawn rates
Lightweight and performance-friendly
Safe to use in existing worlds
